title: How the relationship works.
q1: Do you replace our existing team?
a1: No. Kumar & Associates is intended to complement your team with agreed external capacity. Your firm retains its client relationships, decision-making and professional oversight.
q2: Can we engage you for a single insolvency matter?
a2: Yes. We offer assignment-based support for appropriately scoped matters, as well as ongoing dedicated arrangements. Minimum engagements and fees are discussed based on the work.
q3: Will Kapil personally work on our files?
a3: Founder-led technical casework can be arranged subject to Kapil's availability and confirmation of scope before engagement.
q4: Which accounting platforms do you support?
a4: Our accounting service scope includes work in Xero, MYOB and QuickBooks, subject to the systems and access available for the engagement.
q5: How are confidentiality and quality handled?
a5: We agree on access, confidentiality, deliverables, review responsibilities and escalation processes as part of engagement onboarding. Specific security requirements should be discussed before any client files are shared.
